comment: Lot 6 manual side: 2024 sheet, the classic damage-tolerant fuselage alloy; several lot4 ADs name it as the comparison material.

fields.question: On PDF page 373, Table 3.2.3.0(b1) header: the specification(s) listed for 2024 aluminum alloy sheet and plate. Report exactly as printed.
On PDF page 373, Table 3.2.3.0(b1) header: every temper printed for this table, joined by ';' in printed order.
On PDF page 373, Table 3.2.3.0(b1): the FIRST (leftmost) thickness range column, in inches, under temper T3 whose Basis row prints A and B (not S). Report the range exactly as printed.
On PDF page 373, Table 3.2.3.0(b1): Ftu, L direction, A basis, temper T3, in that same column. Number as printed, without footnote letters.
On PDF page 373, Table 3.2.3.0(b1): Fty, L direction, A basis, temper T3, in that same column. Number as printed, without footnote letters.
On PDF page 373, Table 3.2.3.0(b1): Ftu, ST direction, A basis, temper T3, in that same column. Number as printed; if the cell prints only dots (no value), answer null.
On PDF page 373, Table 3.2.3.0(b1): Fbru for e/D = 2.0, A basis, temper T3, in that same column. Number as printed.
On PDF page 373, Table 3.2.3.0(b1): the tension modulus of elasticity E, in 10^3 ksi, from the physical-properties block for T3 sheet. Number as printed.
On PDF page 373, Table 3.2.3.0(b1): the density (omega, lb/in.3) printed in the physical-properties block. Number as printed.
